children: Shawn M. Lyon, an officer serving as SVP Log & Storage, MPLX GP LLC, sold Common Stock in two transactions on August 28, 2026 and August 31, 2026. The first sale of 425 shares was at a weighted average price of $368.51 per share (range $368.43–$368.53) and the second sale of 1,000 shares was at $375.75 per share. The total sale amount was $532,366. Following these transactions, Lyon directly owns 11,194 shares and indirectly owns 2,938 shares via a 401(k) plan.
